questions.history: On the landing observe a read interrupted while awaiting the first byte, with no data or completion competing.
questions.prediction: The caller should receive InterruptedIOException with its interrupt flag still set, and the subscription should receive cancellation. The PR reports that earlier readers could remain active until an upstream signal.
questions.basis: An interrupted I/O operation has an observable exception and the upstream subscription independently records cancellation. The landed InputStream catch path cancels it.
questions.refutation: The landed read reports ordinary EOF, clears the flag, or leaves the subscription active after propagating the exception.

questions.history: Supply the one-byte buffer 0xff followed by completion, with no interrupt. Call read twice.
questions.basis: InputStream's single-byte read returns an unsigned byte as an int. EOF is a separate result.
questions.refutation: The data byte becomes −1, changes value, or persists beyond completion.

questions.history: On the landing queue bytes A,B,C and leave the source open. With the reader already interrupted, call read(dst, 1, 5) on a seven-byte sentinel-filled array, then read() while no further data is available.
questions.prediction: Expect count 3 and only offsets 1 through 3 replaced by A,B,C. The next read should throw InterruptedIOException with the interrupt flag still set.
questions.basis: A bulk read must report progress already made. A nonzero destination offset tests the actual copied bytes and protects both adjacent sentinels.
questions.refutation: The bulk read loses the partial count, touches another offset, or consumes the interruption before the next empty read.
